context:
Goal: a found gap gets a guard, not a note (your words, 2026-11-07 13:20-13:25 CST).
Problem (rule): your ruling of 2026-10-22 10:10 CDT, in record ste-guard-fixes-not-nags ("No STE hook runs on a write; CI carries the lint"), may cover a lint at push time too.
Based on (measured): PR #1653 pushed four sentences over 30 words. CI found them only after the push, which cost one more fix check (n=1).
Based on (measured): the push-time lint costs 1.2 s on each push that changes Markdown in the lint's scope, and starts nothing otherwise (n=1).
Based on (ruling): ste-guard-fixes-not-nags protects this outcome: no refusal and no process start on each Write or Edit. That still holds, because the lint runs only at push.
Departs from: ste-guard-fixes-not-nags, where CI alone carries the lint — a push that breaks the lint is refused before it leaves, under a new record ste-lint-at-push. A lint crash reads unknown and lets the push go.

options.gain: Prose errors stop before the push, with no extra review round.
options.label: Allow the push-time lint (recommended)
options.lose: About 1.2 s on each push that changes Markdown.

options.gain: Your ruling stands unchanged, and pushes cost no extra time.
options.label: Keep CI only, and drop the lane
options.lose: An over-long sentence still costs one extra fix check now and then.
